_note: Configuration for the weekly AFA job scraper Cloud Function.

_docs.drive_folder_id: The ID of the shared Google Drive folder where the master Excel file is stored. Share this folder with the service account email.
_docs.master_file_name: The filename of the master Excel workbook stored in the Drive folder.
_docs.groups: Array of job title groups. Each group becomes a sheet in the Excel workbook. Each title in 'titles' is queried separately against the AFA API.
